(let ((counts (make-hash-table :test 'equal))
      (page (om:notes :limit 200)))
  (loop
    (dolist (row (om:rows page))
      (incf (gethash (om:field row "kind") counts 0)))
    (let ((next (om:next-page page)))
      (unless next (return))
      (setf page (eval next))))
  (dolist (entry (sort (loop for kind being the hash-keys of counts
                             using (hash-value count)
                             collect (cons kind count))
                       #'string< :key #'car))
    (format t "~a=~d~%" (car entry) (cdr entry))))

(let ((page (om:notes :limit 200))
      (count 0))
  (loop
    (dolist (note (om:rows page))
      (let* ((text (om:note-content note))
             (start 0))
        (loop for pos = (search "port" text :start2 start :test #'char-equal)
              while pos
              for end = (+ pos 4)
              do (when (and (or (zerop pos)
                                (not (alphanumericp (char text (1- pos)))))
                            (or (= end (length text))
                                (not (alphanumericp (char text end)))))
                   (incf count))
                 (setf start end))))
    (unless (om:next-page page) (return))
    (setf page (eval (om:next-page page))))
  (format t "~D" count))
